selectors.form.createIntro: Describe a new content selector with a CSEL expression
selectors.form.examplesHint: Click one to start from it
selectors.form.expressionIntro: The expression that picks the content of repositories.
selectors.form.expressionPlaceholder: Type a CSEL expression (for example, format == "maven2")
selectors.form.name: Name
selectors.form.nameHint: A unique name of the content selector. It cannot be changed later.

selectors.list.about: Content selectors pick out part of the content of repositories. The content is checked against expressions in CSEL, the Content Selector Expression Language.
selectors.list.deleteText: This cannot be undone. A selector that privileges use cannot be deleted; delete those privileges first.
selectors.list.intro: Choose the content users may reach with expressions in CSEL
selectors.list.name: Name
selectors.list.title: Content Selectors
selectors.reference.format: The format of the repository (for example, maven2, npm, docker)
selectors.reference.or: One of the parts must hold
selectors.reference.path: The path of the file in the repository
selectors.reference.title: CSEL Reference
selectors.results.intro: Pick a repository to apply the selector to and see which content it opens.
selectors.results.none: No content in the repositories matches the expression
selectors.results.title: Preview the Selector Results
